paragraphs: Rabbi Chaggai, in Rabbi Abba bar Zavda’s name, and he asked him: Jerusalem Talmud, Terumot chapters 2 and 10. He reported a question from Rabbi Abbahu: Hearel. He supported Zeira: Demai chapter 3; Challah chapter 4. He asked Rabbi Zeira, and Zeira asked Rabbi Ammi, there. He asked Rabbi Yoshiyah. “I was Rabbi Shmuel of Cappadocia’s wedding attendant; I asked Rabbi Yoshiyah; I asked Rabbi Shmuel bar Yitzchak”: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, Hayah Kore, halakhah 6. In Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman’s name: beginning of Shekalim and beginning of chapter 5.
